## Type of change

<!-- Check all that apply. Keep the PR title in Conventional Commits form, e.g. `fix: handle empty input`. -->

- [ ] `fix`: bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] `feat`: new feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] `refactor`: code change with no change in external behavior
- [ ] `style`: formatting only
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` / `build`: tooling, dependencies or automation
- [ ] **Breaking change**: existing behavior changes (describe the migration path in the summary)
